faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about Standard & VIP licensing, 7-day free trial, Lounge TV display, WhatsApp automation, and 100%-owned Custom Projects.

items.q: What is the exact difference between Standard and VIP?
items.a: Standard (1,500 DA/mo · 10,990 DA/yr · 31,000 DA lifetime) is a lightweight offline desktop app for salons with up to 5 workers, covering POS checkout, appointments, live waiting queue, Lounge TV display, manual inventory, basic payroll, and on-screen stats. VIP (2,000 DA/mo · 13,990 DA/yr · 35,500 DA lifetime) unlocks unlimited workers, 24/7 Smart WhatsApp AI Booking Chatbot, automatic client receipts & weekly return reminders, worker WhatsApp alerts, loyalty points, auto consumables deduction, advanced payroll/withdrawals, and printable PDF P&L financial reports (plus custom branding & free showcase website on VIP Lifetime).

items.q: Do both Standard and VIP include a 7-day free trial?
items.a: Yes! Both Standard (salondztech-standard-setup.exe) and VIP (salondztech-vip-setup.exe) include a full 7-day free trial directly on your Windows PC so you can test every workflow on real salon data before purchasing an activation code. You can also try the instant web demo anytime.

items.q: How do Monthly, Yearly, and Lifetime activation codes work?
items.a: After payment via BaridiMob, CCP, Visa, or Mastercard, you immediately receive your activation code directly on WhatsApp: 12-character codes for Monthly (30 days) or Weekly (7 days), 10-character codes for Yearly (365 days — saving ~39% on Standard and ~42% on VIP), and 8-character codes for Lifetime (one-time payment, zero renewals). Each edition has its own dedicated activation codes.

items.q: Does Salon DZ Tech work offline without internet?
items.a: Yes — 100% offline-first! Your POS, appointments, queue, inventory, staff, and local SQLite database run directly on your Windows 10/11 PC with zero cloud fees and zero internet lag. Internet is only needed briefly when activating a license code and (in VIP) for sending automated WhatsApp messages.

items.q: How does the Lounge TV Waiting Queue Display work?
items.a: Included in both Standard and VIP! With one click inside the Queue page, you can either broadcast live over your shop Wi-Fi to any Smart TV / Android TV (via QR scan, salontv.local, or a 4-digit pairing code at salondz.tech/tv) OR open a dedicated fullscreen HDMI window on a 2nd monitor — updating in real time while the cashier freely uses POS, appointments, and settings.

items.q: How does the VIP WhatsApp Chatbot & auto-reminders work?
items.a: In VIP, link your salon's WhatsApp once by scanning a QR code inside Settings. The built-in assistant automatically answers client inquiries 24/7 within your working hours, books appointments directly into your calendar, sends 1-hour appointment reminders, delivers digital receipts after checkout, notifies workers of new bookings, and sends weekly return reminders to past clients.

items.q: What is the Custom Project service? Can you build any idea I have in mind?
items.a: Yes! Our Custom service turns any digital idea that comes to your mind into a real, production-ready product — whether it's a bespoke beauty/salon website with online booking, an iOS & Android mobile app, a multi-branch cloud or desktop management system, an online store, or a completely unique workflow tailored to your business.

items.q: Do I get 100% full ownership and rights to my Custom Project?
items.a: Absolutely — 100% full ownership belongs to you! Every Custom Project follows our transparent 6-step vertical process: (01) Idea & problem discovery, (02) Solution architecture, features & transparent quote, (03) Official signed work contract, (04) Engineering & progress updates, (05) Hands-on testing & client trial, and (06) Full handover with 100% exclusive ownership/rights transferred to you plus complete technical & user documentation (DOC).

items.q: Are Arabic RTL, French, English, and thermal receipt printers supported?
items.a: Yes. You can switch the entire interface seamlessly between Arabic (automatic Right-to-Left layout), French, and English at any time, toggle Light & Dark Mode, and print receipts directly on standard 58mm and 80mm thermal printers as well as A4 printers.

items.q: Can I upgrade from Standard to VIP later, or use it across multiple branches?
items.a: Yes, you can upgrade to VIP anytime while preserving your salon database via built-in JSON backup/import. Each desktop license is bound securely to one machine; for multi-branch chains needing live cloud sync across branches, our Custom Project team can build a tailored multi-branch architecture.

items.q: What happens after I pay for a license?
items.a: We send your activation code immediately on WhatsApp and assist you remotely with installation, service setup, printer calibration, and your first checkout — the entire onboarding takes under 15 minutes.
